lines: Well, howdy! You must be the new owner up at Wildflower Ridge.
Name's Jasper. I run the General Store down the road in town.
Likewise! Folks round here look out for each other.
That mare of yours, Star, she's a good one. Keep her fed and brushed and she'll carry you anywhere.
Feed, tack, seeds, the odd bit of lumber. Everything a ranch needs.
I'm restocking the shelves this week. Come see me in town once the doors are open.
Store's opening soon. Give Star a carrot from me!
